question: In what duties should the disciple be engaged according to the address to the goddess?
premises: The disciple is the object to be engaged
The sphere of engagement is specified
The duties belong to the householder stage
inference: The disciple should be engaged in the duties of the householder stage.
uncertainties: The agent who should engage the disciple is implied rather than explicit.
plain_english: O goddess, one should engage the disciple in the duties of the householder stage.
